title: Quantum chip holds multiple photons at once, opening path to scalable memory
title_zh: 量子芯片可同时容纳多个光子，为可扩展存储器开辟道路
summary: 对于高度脆弱的量子信息系统，存储量子信息的能力至关重要，但也具有挑战性。量子信息以称为光子的光粒子形式传输，光子通常必须暂时暂停（或“存储”），同时其他较慢的量子操作才能赶上。这种存储必须在小至 1 厘米（0.4 英寸）的微芯片上进行——光在几万亿分之一秒内覆盖的距离。将光子存储一微秒将代表量子芯片功能的巨大飞跃。
abstract: For highly fragile quantum information systems, the ability to store quantum information is vital—but also challenging. Quantum information is transported in particles of light called photons, which often must be temporarily paused (or "stored") while other, slower quantum operations catch up. This storage must be performed on microchips as small as 1 centimeter (0.4 inches)—a distance covered by light in a few trillionths of a second. Storing photons for a microsecond would represent a massive leap forward for the capabilities of quantum chips.

title: Unsteady MHD flow of Heat generating / absorbing fluid through porous plate with variable temperature and concentration in a slip flow regime
title_zh: 发热/吸热流体通过多孔板的不稳定 MHD 流动，温度和浓度在滑流状态下变化
summary: 本研究研究了在粘性、不可压缩、导电流体的滑流情况下，通过浸入多孔材料中的无限垂直多孔板进行的非定常磁流体动力学（MHD）自由对流传热和传质。该板受到一致的横向磁场的作用。扰动方法为无量纲控制方程提供了解析解。对影响速度、温度和浓度分布的物理参数进行了图形分析和深入讨论。这些参数包括热格拉霍夫数、修正格拉霍夫数、磁参数、磁导率参数、辐射参数、热量产生/吸收、普朗特数、施密特数、化学反应参数以及索雷特数。
abstract: The present study investigates the unsteady magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) free convective heat and mass transfer flow via an infinite vertical porous plate immersed in a porous material under slip flow circumstances of a viscous, incompressible, electrically conducting fluid. The plate is subjected to a consistent transverse magnetic field. The perturbation approach provides an analytical solution to the non-dimensional governing equations. Physical parameters that affect velocity, temperature, and concentration distributions are graphically analyzed and thoroughly discussed. These parameters include thermal Grashof number, modified Grashof number, magnetic parameter, permeability parameter, radiation parameter, heat generation/absorption, Prandtl number, Schmidt number, chemical reaction parameter, as well as Soret number. According to the findings, the velocity profile rises as the buoyancy and permeability parameters increase, while it falls with the magnetic parameter and slip effects due to the resistive Lorentz force. Thermal radiation and heat source significantly enhance the temperature distribution and thermal boundary layer thickness, while higher Prandtl number reduces the temperature field because of lower thermal diffusivity. The concentration profile decreases with increasing Schmidt number and chemical reaction parameter, whereas it increases with increasing Soret number due to enhanced thermal diffusion effects. The effects of the governing parameters on engineering quantities such as skin friction coefficient, Nusselt number, and Sherwood number are also discussed. The present investigation provides valuable insight into radiative MHD transport phenomena through porous media and has potential applications in geothermal engineering, chemical reactors, nuclear reactor cooling systems, petroleum engineering, energy transport systems, and thermal insulation technologies.
